subject: Post-demo: Pilot scope, token volumes & credits extension request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sana Ahmed <sana@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Brooks <daniel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Pilot scope, token volumes & credits extension request

Hi Sana / Daniel,

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — great discussion and appreciate the deep questions on latency and cost tradeoffs. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Pilot goal: validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization + extraction (approx. 2–4k tokens per session, mostly generation).
- Ask from your side: confirm expected monthly token volumes for a 90-day pilot, target unit economics ($ / 1M tokens), and any budget constraints we should be aware of.

A few clarifying questions so we can size credits and propose the right pilot:
1) What do you expect average monthly token usage during the 90-day pilot (ballpark ranges are fine: e.g., 1M–5M / 5M–15M)?
2) Do you have a target price per 1M tokens you need to hit to make the economics work? You mentioned wanting to be around $120/1M in the meeting — is that still the target?
3) Procurement: will we need an MSA/PO to issue pilot credits or is a simple SOW sufficient to start?

If you can reply with ballpark volume + target $/1M, I can route an internal approval for a credits extension and propose a 30/60/90 check-in cadence to monitor burn rate. I’ve attached the standard pilot terms for reference.

Planned next step: once you confirm volumes & target economics, I’ll request an internal credit extension (usually 1–2M tokens for initial pilots, but we can scale). We’ll also propose a short kickoff call with engineering to get logs/metrics integrated.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot_terms_acme.pdf (stub)

From: Sana Ahmed <sana@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Brooks <daniel@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 18:32:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Pilot scope, token volumes & credits extension request

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and for the demo. Quick answers below: 

1) Pilot volume: we expect ~4M tokens/month initially for the first 30 days (baseline ingestion + generation); if the models perform we could ramp to ~10M tokens/month over the 90-day pilot.
2) Target unit economics: yes, we were hoping to target around $120 / 1M tokens for hosted inference to make the unit economics work at scale. If that changes please flag.
3) Procurement: for a credits-only pilot we can start with a signed SOW (no PO needed up front). Procurement will require a short SOW outlining the credits amount and a statement of work for the pilot.

On credits: could Redwood provide an initial trial credit of ~2M tokens to cover the first 45 days? That will let us validate throughput, integration, and cost per inference. Also can you provide the hosted vs dedicated pricing delta (rough order)? Our security team may request more details on data handling — happy to coordinate.

Happy to do a 30-minute kickoff Tue or Wed next week — we prefer mornings.

Thanks,
Sana Ahmed
Head of AI, Acme Health
sana@acmehealth.com
